Scene layouts — prototype

iPad 12 × 5. Words: gpt-6.1-sol (prompt t8). Placement: code. On a scene's home page the outlined tiles are BlasterAI 60's level-1 words in the same cells they hold on the default board; row 1 is Home and the links to the scene's pages. Topic words fill the rest in colour bands, left to right: pronouns, people, actions, describing, social, things and places. Striped = new word, art drawn by the app. Yellow = a named character or person: the caregiver adds a photo.
